Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The study focuses on glycoproteomics (both N- and O-linked) using FAIMS as a gas-phase separation tool to replace or complement traditional enrichment. While TMT is mentioned in the introduction as used in other studies, the current experimental methods describe label-free DDA runs. The use of EThcD and specific glycan databases confirms a PTM-centric workflow requiring site-level localization.

scope: we analyzed three samples consisting of a mucin-domain glycoprotein, a mixture of recombinant glycoproteins, and a platelet glyco-sheddome
podocalyxin (R&D Systems, 1658-PD) recombinantly expressed in NS0 cells

The protein mixture was created by combining equal masses (5 μg) of each protein. Coagulation factor XII (Invitrogen, RP-43076), von Willebrand factor (Invitrogen, RP-43132), transferrin (R&D systems, 2914-HT), and apolipoprotein E (MoleCular Innovations, HaPo-E-5181) were isolated from human plasma. Bovine α-2-hs-glycoprotein was isolated from plasma (Fetuin, Promega, V4961), and monocyte differentiation antigen CD14 was recombinantly expressed in CHO cells (R&D systems, 383-CD-050/CF).

Expired apheresis platelets (BloodWorks Northwest, 2965-02) were enriched using wheat germ agglutinin (WGA) using previously described methods. In short, seven apheresis units were washed and lysed by using sonication. The supernatant was collected and enriched by using a WGA agarose (Vector Laboratories, AL-1023) gravity flow column.

Ontology_ProcessingAndDifferential_promp.notes: The dataset is highly specialized for glycoproteomics. A critical processing note is the 'in-FAIMS fragmentation' (IFF) phenomenon, which creates false-positive glycopeptide identifications by losing glycans during gas-phase separation. Reanalysis must account for this to avoid overestimating glycoform diversity.
